hook.sub: They watch a cartoon. You train in the same room.

items.title: Theme song warm-up

icon.label: Arm circles, squats, march in place

items.line: The theme song is your timer. When it stops, you start.

items.title: The circuit
items.line: Two dumbbells. No jumping. Rest a minute.

items.title: Repeat until credits
items.line: Round after round. Credits roll, you are done.
items.tip: Autoplay the next one? Bonus round.

items.title: Let them count
items.line: They count your reps out loud.

end.tease: 10 minutes to undo a day at the desk
